}}'''Caban''' is a [[Seanchan]] soldier who served under the command of [[Egeanin Tamarath]] prior to the battle at [[Falme]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Caban}}

== Appearance ==
He has dark eyes and is into his middle years. He has an old scar above his eyes and another nicking his chin.

== Activities ==
He is part of the Seanchan force that boards [[Bayle Domon]]'s ship, the [[Spray]]. He is left on board as the ship sails to [[Falme]] to dock.{{ref/book|2|29}}
